culture.en: And I think this trend is a response to burnout and modern working cultures.
culture.zh: 我认为这种趋势是对职业倦怠和现代工作文化的一种回应。

culture.en: This same behavior, “being late “, can have completely different meanings depending on the culture.
culture.zh: 同样的“迟到”行为，根据文化的不同，可能会有完全截然相反的含义。

culture.en: Things repeat. In cyclical time cultures, time doesn’t really have a beginning or end.
culture.zh: 它只是在某种程度上不断地周而复始。

culture.en: Some wartime dishes are still around today and they’re examples of British food culture.
culture.zh: 一些战争时期的菜肴至今仍然存在，它们是英国饮食文化的代表。

culture.en: Even if their culture is ancient, the official country might still be relatively new.
culture.zh: 即使它们的文化是古老的，官方的国家可能依然相对较新。

current.en: The current consensus is that George III is likely to have had bipolar disorder.
current.zh: 目前的共识是，George III 很可能患有双相情感障碍。

current.en: And am I learning from those mistakes? Or is my current learning method effective?
current.zh: 我是否在从这些错误中吸取教训？或者我目前的学习方法是否有效？

current.en: Questions that connect the current topic to the original goal and keep the conversation moving.
current.zh: 那些能将当前话题与最初目标联系起来并让对话继续推进的问题。

current.en: But we can't turn our noses up at the current data – the observational data.
current.zh: 但我们不能对现有的数据——即观察性数据——嗤之以鼻。

current.en: How I have gone from zero to my current level over the 10 years.
current.zh: 这10年里，我是如何从零基础走到今天的水平的。

customer.en: It’s used in medicine, translation, customer service, research, and creative industries.
customer.zh: 它被用于医学、翻译、客户服务、研究和创意产业。

customer.en: Call centre work involves dealing with customers who've phoned up to complain.
customer.zh: 呼叫中心的工作包括应对打电话来投诉的客户。

customer.en: They could pose as Silk Road customers, or even sellers, blending into the marketplace like anyone else.
customer.zh: 他们可以伪装成 The Silk Road 的顾客，甚至是卖家，像其他人一样融入这个市场。

customer.en: They quietly record customers as they move in the shop.
customer.zh: 它们在顾客在店内移动时静静地记录着。

customer.en: And I enjoyed it. I enjoyed my customers; I enjoyed the kindness, and I enjoyed every part of it.
customer.zh: 我很享受。我很享受我的客户；我享受那种善意，并且我享受其中的每一部分。

curriculum.en: So let me design this curriculum so that it's in-attendance (ph) tolerant.
curriculum.zh: 所以，让我来设计这个课程，让它对出勤具有容忍度（ph）。

curriculum.en: The structured curriculum can provide the knowledge, communication opportunities, gives you a reason to use your knowledge.
curriculum.zh: 结构化的课程大纲可以提供知识，而交流机会则给了你使用知识的理由。

curriculum.en: Now, in terms of what students would study at these universities, the curriculum was surprisingly uniform.
curriculum.zh: 现在，就学生在这些大学里学习的内容而言，课程出奇地统一。

curriculum.en: In fact, our training curriculum is often quite the opposite.
curriculum.zh: 事实上，我们的培训课程往往恰恰相反。

curriculum.en: But it was all structured around a planned curriculum.
curriculum.zh: 但这一切都是围绕着一个有计划的课程大纲构建的。

currently.en: And currently two sisters, Ellie and Rachel Reeves, are senior ministers in the British government.
currently.zh: 目前还有两姐妹埃利和蕾切尔·里夫斯，她们是英国政府的高级大臣。

currently.en: So, how many Instagram posts can you currently find under the hashtag 'declutter'?
currently.zh: 那么，你目前能在Instagram上找到多少带有“declutter”（断舍离）标签的帖子？

currently.en: I asked you how many Instagram posts you can currently find under the hashtag 'declutter'.
currently.zh: 我问你目前能在Instagram上找到多少带有“declutter”标签的帖子。

currently.en: The interest, which is currently at around 10%, would have to be lowered a lot, to 3%.
currently.zh: 目前高达10%左右的利率，必须大幅下调，降至3%。

currently.en: I live in Japan, which is currently considering making major changes to some of its visas.
currently.zh: 我住在日本，日本目前正在考虑对其部分签证进行重大修改。

curious.en: Just head to community.leonardoenglish.com and get chatting away with other curious minds.
curious.zh: 欢迎前往 community.leonardoenglish.com，与其他求知欲旺盛的听众一起交流探讨。

curious.en: OK then, that is it for today's episode on the curious history of perfume.
curious.zh: 好了，今天关于香水奇妙历史的节目就到这里。

curious.en: So, I’m curious what you think. What do you think makes a city great?
curious.zh: 所以，我很好奇你们怎么看。你们觉得是什么让一座城市变得伟大？

curious.en: I'm curious. Yeah. It doesn't seem to be an end to your curiosity either.
curious.zh: 我很好奇。是的，你的好奇心似乎永无止境。

curious.en: I've experimented with hiring external scriptwriters to write episodes of English Learning for Curious Minds.
curious.zh: 我曾尝试雇佣外部编剧来为 English Learning for Curious Minds 撰写脚本。

cucumber.en: And puke rhymes with 'cuc', so it's a way of reminding her to buy cucumbers.
cucumber.zh: 而且puke和“cuc”押韵，所以这是提醒她买黄瓜的一种方式。

cucumber.en: Aha! Cucumbers make Joanna's husband puke – a slang word for vomit.
cucumber.zh: 啊哈！黄瓜让Joanna的丈夫感到想吐puke——这是一个表示呕吐的俚语。

cucumber.en: They have their own take on the hamburger wherein they'll use lettuce, and raw cucumbers, and a type of fry sauce - that's called a shalpuborgari, or a shop burger, and that's been around for ages.
cucumber.zh: 他们有自己对汉堡的独特理解，他们会使用生菜、生黄瓜以及一种炸菜酅，这种汉堡被称为 shalpuborgari，或者叫店锯汉堡，这丬东西已经存在很久了。

cupboard.en: The answer is to go slow, as she explains here to BBC Radio 4's Woman's Hour: You have to do decluttering slowly but surely: one drawer, one cupboard at a time.
cupboard.zh: 答案是慢慢来，正如她在这里向BBC广播四台的《女性时间》解释的那样：你必须稳扎稳打地进行断舍离：一次一个抽屉，一次一个橱柜。

cue.en: In some experiments, dogs outperform even chimpanzees at understanding basic human cues.
cue.zh: 在某些实验中，狗在理解人类基本手势方面的表现甚至超过了黑猩猩。

cue.en: Also in my manner, I would hope, and in my non-verbal cues.
cue.zh: 另外我也希望通过我的态度以及我的非言语线索来做到这一点。

cue.en: And finally, non-verbal cues are types of communication using facial expressions, hand gestures or tone of voice, rather than speech, to show your feelings.
cue.zh: 最后，non-verbal cues（非言语线索）是指使用面部表情、手势或语调而不是言语来进行沟通，以表达你感受的交流方式。

cue.en: The first R is recognizing emotion, the ability to know what you're feeling, know what another person is feeling, to recognize emotions through nonverbal cues or verbal ones.
cue.zh: 第一个R是“识别情绪”，也就是知道自己此刻的感受，知道另一个人的感受，能够通过非语言线索或语言线索来识别情绪的能力。

cue.en: And I love that cue. So during the times when I'm doing things, like that Sam episode, I'm like, the next question and there's millions of people watching it and all this stuff.
cue.zh: 我很喜欢这个提示。所以当我在做事情的时候，比如那期Sam的节目，我在想：下一个问题，有数百万人看着，所有这些东西。

cure.en: Is clay good for: a) curing headaches? b) digesting food? or, c) smoothing face skin?
cure.zh: 粘土有何妙用：a) 治疗头痛？b) 消化食物？还是 c) 平滑面部皮肤？

cure.en: The cure is control. His method is simple, and it is brutal.
cure.zh: 治愈的方法是控制。他的方法很简单，也很残酷。

cure.en: False claims about vaccines, miracle cures, government conspiracies, and the origins of the virus circulated everywhere.
cure.zh: 关于疫苗、奇迹疗法、政府阴谋以及病毒来源的虚假声明到处流传。

cunning.en: He wasn't a nice man. He was cunning, lazy, greedy, and easily upset.
cunning.zh: 他不是个好人。他狡猾、懒惰、贪婪，而且很容易暴躁。

cunning.en: Beware the devil; he has evil and cunning ways, and he is sending witches to test you.
cunning.zh: 警惕魔鬼；他诡计多端、阴险狡诈，正派遣女巫来考验你们。

cunning.en: One politician, and man of noble blood, Atanius Secundus, had what he must have thought was a cunning idea.
cunning.zh: 有一位政治家、出身高贵的 Atanius Secundus 想到了一个他自己认为是精明的主意。

cunning.en: It was a cunning system indeed, and did allow these men to complete what has been described as one of the first instances of underwater archaeology.
cunning.zh: 这确实是一个巧妙的系统，确实让这些人完成了被描述为水下考古最早实例之一的任务。

cunning.en: Now, some monarchs are remembered in the history books for their cunning and intelligence, their ability to navigate international politics, manage internal unrest, and leave the country in a stronger position than how they found it.
cunning.zh: 有些君主在历史书上因其狡猾和智慧而被铭记，他们能够驾驭国际政治、处理国内动荡，并使国家处于比他们接手时更强大的位置。

custom.en: And folklore is a broader term that includes stories, customs, beliefs, and traditions held by people.
custom.zh: 而民间故事则是一个更广泛的概念，包括人们所持有的故事、习俗、信仰和传统。

custom.en: Everything feels different. The systems, rules and customs are not the same as in your home country.
custom.zh: 一切感觉都不同了。体制、规则和习俗与你的祖国不尽相同。

custom.en: They learned the Irish language. They adopted Irish customs.
custom.zh: 他们学习爱尔兰语，采纳爱尔兰习俗。

custom.en: In terms of his parents, he came from a modest background; his father was a customs officer, and his mother was a devout Muslim.
custom.zh: 至于他的父母，他出身于一个普通家庭；他的父亲是一名海关官员，母亲是一位虔诚的穆斯林。

custom.en: He spoke Arabic, he understood local customs and traditions, and he felt more at home in the Middle East than he did back in England.
custom.zh: 他会说阿拉伯语，了解当地的习俗和传统，而且他在中东比在英国老家感觉更自在。

curtain.en: So, there we go, a peek behind the curtain, a look inside how these episodes are made.
curtain.zh: 好了，以上就是对幕后制作过程的揭秘。

curtain.en: I called her up to ask her what pulled the curtain back.
curtain.zh: 我打电话给她，问是什么拉开了这层帷幕。

curtain.en: To his middle-class readers sipping their tea and sitting on comfortable armchairs, the book pulled back the curtain on a world they knew existed, but understood effectively nothing about.
curtain.zh: 对于那些端着茶杯、坐在舒适扶手椅上的中产阶级读者来说，这本书拉开了帷幕，让他们看到了一个他们知道存在却几乎一无所知的世界。

curl.en: Humans began to write ' breed standards– strict rules on exactly how a dog’s tail should curl or how long its nose should be.
curl.zh: 人类开始编写“品种标准”——关于狗的尾巴应该如何卷曲或鼻子应该有多长的严格规则。

cultivate.en: He cultivated connections with businessmen, security officials, and younger members of the royal family.
cultivate.zh: 他与商人、安全官员以及王室年轻一代建立了联系。

cultivate.en: Farmers cultivated crops like maize (which is corn), beans, squash, and chili peppers.
cultivate.zh: 农民种植了诸如玉米（也就是玉米）、豆类、南瓜和辣椒等农作物。

cultivate.en: He also cultivated a very specific image of himself: the fearless leader.
cultivate.zh: 他还精心打造了一个非常独特的个人形象：无所畏惧的领袖。

cultivate.en: Is this capacity innate and fixed, or an ability we can cultivate?
cultivate.zh: 这种能力究竟是与生俱来、固定不变的，还是一种我们可以后天培养的技能呢？

cultivate.en: I think all you can do is kind of cultivate an appreciation and gratitude for what you have.
cultivate.zh: 我认为你所能做的就是培养对你所拥有的东西的欣赏和感激。

currency.en: That's right. I used to think, you know, the currency of life, right?
currency.zh: 没错。我曾经认为，你知道，这是生命的货币，对吧？

currency.en: And now the Euro is one of the world’s most powerful currencies.
currency.zh: 现在，欧元已经成为世界上最强大的货币之一。

currency.en: You're not paying attention. So the real currency of life is attention.
currency.zh: 你没有集中注意力。所以生命的真正货币是注意力。

currency.en: The value of the British currency fell, and her government had to abandon all of those plans instantly.
currency.zh: 英镑贬值，她的政府不得不立即废除了所有这些计划。

currency.en: Knowing the right people — and being trusted by them — is one of the most powerful currencies in the country.
currency.zh: 认识对的人——并获得他们的信任——是这个国家最有价值的资本之一。

curiosity.en: Henslow recognized Darwin’s curiosity and encouraged him to pursue his interests and study nature.
curiosity.zh: Henslow发现了Darwin的好奇心，并鼓励他追求自己的兴趣去研究自然。

curiosity.en: They also tend to learn more. Asking good questions demonstrates curiosity, confidence, and respect.
curiosity.zh: 他们往往也学得更多。提出好问题体现了好奇心、自信和尊重。

curiosity.en: I'm curious. Yeah. It doesn't seem to be an end to your curiosity either.
curiosity.zh: 我很好奇。是的，你的好奇心似乎永无止境。

curiosity.en: If I want to learn something, I do it at the moment of curiosity.
curiosity.zh: 如果我想学习什么，我会在好奇心产生的瞬间去做。

curiosity.en: Actually, Leonardo’s curiosity was probably one of his weaknesses, as well as one of his strengths.
curiosity.zh: 事实上，列奥纳多的好奇心可能既是他的优势，也是他的弱点之一。

curve.en: But as it trains these new hires, Zappos also throws them a curve ball.
curve.zh: 但在培训这些新员工的同时，Zappos 也给他们出了个难题。

curve.en: Right? And, you look across any technology, there it is: there's the S-shape diffusion curve.
curve.zh: 对吧？你随便看哪一项技术，都能发现它：那条S型扩散曲线就在那儿。

curve.en: Their weapon of choice was a curved sword with devastating cutting power.
curve.zh: 他们首选的武器是一种具有极强切割力的弯刀。

curve.en: But it's about the number of iterations that drives a learning curve.
curve.zh: 但正是迭代的次数推动了学习曲线。

curve.en: And I think they're going to bend the curve on healthcare costs.
curve.zh: 我认为它们将改变医疗成本的曲线。

customary.en: If this sounds unusual, it wasn’t. It was fairly customary in the Ottoman Empire for children not to be given a surname, as they would typically acquire other names, other ways of identifying themselves, later on in life.
customary.zh: 如果这听起来很不寻常，其实并非如此。在奥斯曼帝国，不给儿童起姓氏是相当普遍的习俗，因为他们通常会在日后的生活中通过其他名字或方式来表明自己的身份。

curse.en: The resource curse does not mean natural resources are inherently bad or always bad.
curse.zh: 资源诅咒并不意味着自然资源本质上是坏的或者总是坏的。

curse.en: History also should be important. Many countries facing the resource curse share colonialism.
curse.zh: 历史也应该很重要。许多面临资源诅咒的国家都有着共同的殖民历史。

curse.en: No. No? No. That's the curse of what I do.
curse.zh: 不。不是吗？不。那是我的职业带来的诅咒。

curse.en: Exactly. That's exactly what it is. That's the curse.
curse.zh: 没错。就是这样。这就是诅咒。

cushion.en: Some grew so weak and bony, they couldn't sit without cushions or raise their arms to wash their hair.
cushion.zh: 有些人虚弱骨感得甚至无法在没有坐垫的情况下安坐，也无法抬起胳膊洗头。
